_meta.title: Example OTSM Network of Problems + DIKWP purpose layer
_meta.note: Synthetic four-node example showing the shape `triz_graph` and `triz_purpose` expect. Nodes are open contradictions; edges are typed. Replace with your own project graph and point TRIZ_GRAPH at it.

edge_types.couples: share an element; part of the same cluster (stored from->to)
edge_types.blocks: target cannot be resolved until source is
edge_types.dissolves: resolving source removes the target contradiction outright

_meta.purpose_layer: Each node's `purpose` is the invariant it serves. `purpose.spec` binds it to a machine-checkable specification; a purpose counts as secured only when a `verified_by` record exists on the node or on a linked registry entry (see examples/triz-registry.json).
_meta.contradiction: Optional. A node may carry a `contradiction` in the PhysicalContradiction form of the function-model schema (skills/triz-innovation/schemas/function-model.schema.json). `triz_graph` checks it with separationCheck and reports irreducible, separable, no-contradiction, or invalid; an invalid one fails closed for that node only. P1 carries one that separates in time.

nodes.title: Throughput vs. defect escape
nodes.pc: The line must run fast to meet demand and slow to let inspection catch defects.

demands.because: inspection dwell long enough to catch defects

purpose.statement: No defective unit reaches a customer.

nodes.title: Inspection cost vs. coverage
nodes.pc: Coverage must be complete to be trusted and partial to be affordable.

purpose.statement: Inspection spend stays inside the approved envelope.

nodes.title: Rework capacity vs. lead time
nodes.pc: Rework must be local to be fast and centralized to be economic.

purpose.statement: Promised lead time is never exceeded.

nodes.title: Supplier variety vs. qualification effort
nodes.pc: Supply must be diverse to be resilient and narrow to stay qualified.

purpose.statement: A single supplier failure never halts the line.
